nom: The Ordinary Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum with Vitamin C and Ginseng

segments.oily: One reviewer describes oily/acneic skin and reports the serum sinks in quickly, leaves more of a glow than grease, and helps with acne scars and redness, though the odor is called offensive; another with combination (oily to dry) skin reports brighter skin and smaller-looking pores.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal/dry skin report the serum feels hydrating and non-tacky, absorbing without leaving a heavy or oily coat, with one noting her skin still looks dull despite improvement and another calling it very hydrating for dry, dull skin.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers identify as having sensitive skin and report the serum did not break them out or cause irritation, with one specifying it worked well for her skin type overall.
segments.mature: One reviewer reports the serum minimizes the look of fine lines and wrinkles and leaves mature-looking skin smoother and more youthful.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing normal/dry, deep skin tone reports a light, non-tacky texture and more even, radiant skin tone with reduced dark spot visibility.

concerns.aging: Reviewers mention reduced appearance of fine lines and a more youthful, smoother look; this is reported by only a couple of reviewers rather than broadly across the set.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers report increased hydration, plumping, and a non-sticky, non-tacky finish; one reviewer states the product was 'not very hydrating' for her.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness within weeks; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the serum strengthens the skin barrier while keeping it hydrated; no other reviewer discusses barrier function directly.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, or acne marks within one to several weeks; one reviewer notes she has not yet seen results after a short time of use.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers report no new breakouts and scarring clearing up, while one reviewer reports new small bumps forming all over her forehead and chin after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the finish looks like glow rather than grease and does not leave an oily coat; another notes a slightly oily consistency that does not translate to an oily feel on skin.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and makeup

extraits.titre: Got weird bumps all over my forehead and chin
extraits.texte: I just wanted to find an affordable vitamin C cerum, but after using this product, I started seeing small bumps form all over my forehead, and I have never had them before.

extraits.titre: good serum for oily, acneic skin
extraits.texte: a lot of serums can be too heavy on my skin and give me whiteheads. this sinks in quickly and while I do look a bit shinier after using it, I think it looks more like a glow rather than grease. has helped with my acne scars and redness also. I will say the odor is a little offensive; this contains fungal extract and you definitely get that pungent earthy smell from it, but it fades pretty quick.

I absolutely love the ordinary multi-antioxidant, radiating serum. I was gifted by the ordinary in exchange for a review and I really liked the product. I have super sensitive skin, but the product worked amazing on my skin type.

the ordinary never misses! this is another beautiful addition to their collection of serums. it effectively hydrates the skin while also minimizing the look of fine lines and wrinkles. I enjoy that this serum helps protect skin against environmental stressors that can cause you to age faster. my skin has never looked so smooth, and youthful. I actually recieved a compliment about the way my skin looks shortly after incorporating this into my routine and it was all because of this product!! I do want to mention I also have very dry skin that can tend to look dull and this adds a beautiful radiance to the skin. the ordinary really creates products that look and feel like high end but have such a good price point. I always feel so luxurious while using their products. they perform so well and fit perfectly into my routines.

extraits.titre: It's Effective as it is Smelly lol
extraits.texte: Skin Profile: Dark/Deep Skin color, Normal/Dry skin Texture 4/5: The serum has a light consistency without being completely watery which I prefer. It also absorbs into the skin fairly quickly and leaves the skin feeling normal (non-tacky). I use this at night after washing my face and in the morning before putting on my sunscreen (I don't have to use moisturizer with my sunscreen). Effectiveness 4.5/5: While I did use this in tandem with Cerave's retinol serum, I have experienced more evenness and radiance when it comes to my skin-tone; unless you look closely at my skin my dark spots are not as pronounced. Scent 3.5/5: Although I do smell the undercurrent of fishiness that other people have commented on, it dissipates after a few seconds. It does not disturb my self-care experience, so I keep using it. The serum is fragrance free which is why I added the point five😅 Overall, 4/5: Does what it says...Yay

extraits.titre: Good addition to my skincare routine
extraits.texte: Complimentary from the Ordinary. The product is the perfect addition to my skincare routine. It feels lightweight, it absorbs quickly into the skin, and protects your skin against the environment. Within a few weeks I noticed my dark spots fade and reduce redness. I live in a state where the weather changes all the time and with allergy season approaching it's been hard to find a products that helps protect against those environmental stressors that causes my skin to break out. It's good for sensitive skin and overall my skin loves it

I'm not sure I've noticed much of a difference with this serum, and the slightly off-putting fishy smell makes it not pleasant to use. Not very hydrating. Definitely would not repurchase and will probably struggle to get through the bottle!
